title: What is Vector database?
description: A vector database stores embedding vectors so search finds meaning, not keywords. How similarity indexes work and how builders use them.
lead: A vector database is a purpose-built store for embedding vectors that returns the closest matches to a query by meaning rather than by keyword. It pairs an approximate nearest-neighbor index with metadata filters and plain horizontal scaling, so a retrieval layer can fetch the right passages in milliseconds. Builders use it as the memory behind grounded answers: chunk, embed, store once, then retrieve the top passages at query time and hand them to the model.
